blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Friday allayed fears from business groups that the recent overhaul in the Marcos administration’s key revenue-generating agencies could result in economic disruption. This concern comes after yet another shake-up in the Marcos Cabinet involving the Bureau of Customs (BOC), Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), and the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (Peza). READ: Asean Summit to cover transnational crimes, migrant workers, oil supply In the latest move, Customs Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno has been named the new president and chief executive officer of the BCDA.
